wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Schedule A (p2) is struck out: the filer drew a slashed-zero glyph across the first writing line and left every other line empty, and both printed total cells hold the same slashed zero = 0. Box B (this period) $0.00 and Box C (year-to-date) $0.00 agree, so the two scopes coincide. le50 keys null: this form prints no separate $50-or-less line.

expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p3) is struck out the same way (slashed zero on the first line, both printed total cells a slashed zero = 0). Zero rows equal Box D (Expenditures Made This Period, $0.00) and the schedule's own per-report total, but NOT Box E (Expenditures Made Year-to-Date, $4,896.63). The rows are therefore on the PERIOD scope — a different scope from the cumulative figure this module publishes, which is honest and expected here: the cover marks this a Seven-days-preceding-the-General amendment of the 6-11-2024 report and the filer wrote 'No change since previous report' on it. The $4,896.63 of year-to-date spending is itemized in the EARLIER filing, not this one; nothing was borrowed or differenced.

gates.page_subtotal: p2: zero rows = printed subtotal (Ø) = printed total (Ø) — gates. p3: zero rows = printed subtotal (Ø) = printed total (Ø) — gates.
gates.row_count: Not applicable in the counting sense — both ruled grids are entirely uninked apart from the single struck-out zero glyph on line 1 of each, read at 600 dpi; 0 rows emitted on both sides.
gates.geometry_proof: No rows to place, so no row geometry is claimed. The two nil glyphs were located and rendered directly (p2 and p3, first writing line, ~y 18% of the page) and the printed subtotal/total cells at ~y 84-89% were each re-rendered at 600 dpi.
gates.balance_chain: Box A $0.00 + Box B $0.00 = Box F — but Box F is left BLANK, as is 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period'. The chain therefore cannot be closed on the page; the three figures that ARE printed (A, B, D all $0.00) are mutually consistent. Cross-filing test not possible within this chunk: the report it amends (6-11-2024) is a different document and is not in this chunk.

escalation_note: 600 dpi crops of the p4 A/B/C block, the p4 D/E block and the p4 F / Balance-at-Close block; plus 600 dpi crops of the p2 first line and both schedules' printed total cells.
